_doc: Per-country public holidays (YYYY-MM-DD). Weekends (Sat/Sun) are ALWAYS non-business and need no entry here. A client's country comes from clients.icp_config.geo. Used by factory/packages/calendar_bd.py + release.py + reports.py so a client never gets a report on a non-business day; the content delivers on the next business day instead. Add years/countries as clients are added.
